name: Sync Tactics
detailed_description:
A TACTICAL RPG WITH ONLINE MULTIPLAYER AND NO RNG 

Sync Tactics is a strategic, fully deterministic tactical RPG. Its gameplay is inspired by the most classic titles of the genre but with two key differences: the absence of random factors in battles and a unique simultaneous turn system that enables both cooperative and competitive play.

FEATURES

  • Single-player or online co-op campaign: Play the entire campaign solo, in co-op, or seamlessly switch between the two. Every mission supports up to 5 players, and most can be played with larger teams of up to 12!

  • Online competitive modes: Challenge your friends in competitive matches and large-scale battles. The innovative Sync Tactics system allows matches between teams of different sizes, whether it's 1v1, 2v2, 1v3, 10v7, or any combination up to 12v12.

  • Simultaneous Turns: Each turn in Sync Tactics is divided into a Planning Phase, where all players plan their robots' actions, followed by an Execution Phase, where the robots carry out their instructions based on the planned actions.

  • Factory: Every robot is fully customizable, with each component providing a unique action that can be used during matches. The Factory enables you to create and assemble limitless combinations of robot squads to tackle any challenge.

  • Hundreds of Components: As you advance through the campaign, you'll encounter a wide variety of new components that allow you to continually upgrade your squad. Each new part opens up fresh possibilities for enhancing your robots' capabilities, enabling you to experiment with different configurations.

FREE TO SHARE

Sync Tactics promotes cooperative gameplay.
If you bought a copy, you can host cooperative matches with friends who don't own the game. Just have them download the demo from Steam, or the free mobile version, and join your game. Any progress they make will carry over to the full version.

short_description: Sync Tactics is a simultaneous turn-based tactical RPG with deep strategic elements. Command a squad of fully customizable robots, collect components, upgrade your units, and engage in quick battles or large-scale competitive challenges, either solo or through online co-op mode.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3 or AMD Phenom™ X3 8650
  • Memory: 3 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 600 series, AMD Radeon™ HD 7000 series
  • DirectX: Version 8.0
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7 or AMD Ryzen™ 5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060/ GeForce® GTX 1650 or AMD R9 380/AMD RX 6400 or Intel® Arc™ A770
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
